edition.title: Primary Visual Cortex as a Saliency Map: A Parameter-Free Prediction and Its Test by Behavioral Data

source_native_original_central_structure: Feature-tuned V1 population responses and iso-feature contextual suppression
Each location represented by largest relative V1 response, independent of feature label, not weighted average of feature maps
Fixed-background monotonic decreasing response-to-latency assumption permits reaction-time race algebra
C/M/O singleton and CM/CO/MO paired types, assuming no jointly color-motion-orientation tuned V1 CMO cell
Eq30 non-spurious race equality: min(RT_CMO,RT_C,RT_M,RT_O) has same distribution as min(RT_CM,RT_CO,RT_MO) under original source conditional response assumptions
Quantitative RT_CMO distribution inferred from other six RT distributions and tested against original human button-press behavior, not direct neural computation measurement
original_model_variants: RE6-RE8 complex spurious race variants Eqs32-34 matched procedural complexity
green vs purple same-original stimulus-pool conditions
CO and MO established conjunction responses, CM neuronal prevalence source disputed, CMO absence CONDITIONAL hypothesis
direct_original_ancestry: Li/Zhaoping earlier 1999/2002 V1 saliency hypothesis and iso-feature suppression neurally hypothesized
Koene & Zhaoping 2007 original previously collected human singleton-search reaction-time data, not newly collected experiments in this 2015 analysis
earlier eye-of-origin singleton and texture-border V1 saliency predictions

adverse_scope_before_A.scope: V1 response relative maximum is the hypothesized visual salience representation; neural identification not directly measured in the reused behavioral trials.
RT inversely tracks salience only when fixed other-item responses and negligible top-down/context variation and low motor-readout noise; not arbitrary human behavior.
V1 CMO-tuned-neuron absence is anatomical/data-motivated assumption, not source-conclusive cell census; CM double-tuned prevalence explicitly contested.
Failure to reject Eq30 by limited subjects and sampling power does not uniquely identify biological V1 as sole full generator.
Eight observers original acquisition, only six with CMO response samples; six original non-spurious behavioral tests only.
Green-condition faster C singleton creates floor/low-power effects; some deliberately spurious race equalities survive.
Possible extrastriate CMO responses negligible or Eq35 property, and other salience pathways: extrastriate exclusion not firmly established.
Independence of cell-response fluctuations, fixed background, normalization approximations, imperfect color isoluminance and stable learning/gain admitted idealizations.
Complex scenes, multiple saccades, predictable task features and top-down goal-dependent processing outside proved scope.
Source spurious equalities RE6 and RE7 often rejected, RE8 frequently not rejected; no blanket all-control-falsified claim.

family_pre_a.already_qualified_P05: 2022 IVSN (inherited 2018 IVSN) top-down feature-map visual search plus IOR/salience and return fixation mechanism; overlap at stimulus/attention but P06 V1 maximum-response race relation is neither equivalent nor final independently proved.
